rules: Standalone TOML per custom agent with name, description, developer_instructions; optional model, model_reasoning_effort, sandbox_mode.
Descriptions route narrow specialists; read-only sandbox prevents shared file edits.

inspirations.observed: The editor sees target text only, preserves deliberate strangeness and repetition, notes uncertain semantics, and leaves sound text alone.
adapted_rules: quote_editor has a strict target-only packet boundary and a pass/no-change review for each ID.
Unknown meaning becomes an uncertainty sent to the coordinator, not a guessed correction.

inspirations.observed: Source-aware verification separates original peculiarity from translation error and permits unresolved verdicts.
adapted_rules: quote_fidelity distinguishes source peculiarity, acceptable adaptation, mistranslation, and unresolved evidence.
Fidelity gives not_checked when the original language or exact edition is unavailable.

inspirations.observed: Reflection checks accuracy, fluency, style, and terminology and uses a bounded source neighborhood. Its critic can see the source and does not require a no-change verdict.
adapted_rules: Accuracy and claims go to quote_fidelity; fluency and reader effect go to blind quote_editor.
All reviewers return a row for every ID, including clean items, and changes require concrete impact.
The coordinator supplies only relevant source context to source-aware roles.
Preserve the union of locale records, stable IDs, and distinct phrases; similarity never merges records.
Research uses the supplied source first and at most three targeted searches per uncached work or reference.
Shipped material survives failed lookup; scripture requires approved exact-edition evidence.
Candidate hashes and review coverage bind adjudication to an exact revision.

evaluation_handoff: A/B test frozen translator cases for distinct near-synonyms, claim preservation, and literary voice.
A/B test blind editor on sound unusual prose and a genuine target-language calque.
Test fidelity on source peculiarity versus mistranslation and an intermediate-language-only hold.
Check exact JSON coverage and rejection of extra or missing IDs before adoption.
limits: These files are draft agent configurations; no agent execution or A/B result is claimed here.
The coordinator must give blind agents fresh context and only the allowed packet; the TOML alone cannot enforce context isolation.

app_role_basis.adaptation: Existing screen-context, target-only review, claim-preservation and evidence-based mobile-fit rules were scoped into app_localizer and app_copy_editor; no competitor-popularity or fit claim without inspected evidence.
